$comment: Settings for the 'prod' environment: real money on Revolut X (epic #72, ADR-0017), next to dev's paper. Read by tools/azure/*.ps1; no secrets here. protected: true keeps paper's CI, the dashboard's requests and reset-database.ps1 out (CI deploys new images here only in runs the owner approves, ADR-0019), mounts the exchange keys in the engine (which stands by in paper until the owner switches it), and makes provision.ps1 check that no service principal but the deploy's own holds a role on the group. Its database is its own, in the shared account (owner decision 5). Runbook: docs/live-trading.md.

agents.$comment: As in dev.json (ADR-0013): deploy platform first, then apps with -PromoteFrom dev -ImageTag <commit SHA> and the exchange key files. startEngine: true runs the engine, which stands by until the owner switches it (docs/live-trading.md); false stops it and its agent runs.
